name: return35-early-distribution-5329
description: P53 Form 5329 Part I: 10,000 of early retirement distribution subject to the §72(t)(1) additional tax -> 1,000, an OTHER tax added after credits.
note: Hand-verified: single, taxable 60,000-15,000=45,000 -> tax 1,000+3,600+1,100=5,700. Plus 10% x 10,000 = 1,000 -> liability 6,700; wh 7,000 -> refund 300. PLACEHOLDER rules.
